engine → Frappe results signed with HMAC-SHA256 (timestamp + body)
Bearer API key per tenant on every /v1 call; key never in browser code
console login with a signed HttpOnly cookie (12 h)
ports bound to 127.0.0.1 and the Tailscale address only; DB/Redis on 127.0.0.1
redaction before any LLM step (name, phone, e-mail, ID, dob, nationality, gender, address)
raw national ID never leaves Frappe: id_token = HMAC-SHA256(national_id, secret)
AI fields and identity at permission level 1 (HR roles only)
every HR method refuses other users first (permanent test)
public form rate limit per IP
CV size limit 10 MB and allowed extensions
consent recorded with its version; withdrawal stops processing and deletes the pool profile
retention period for the talent pool
every AI action and HR decision in the audit log (with reason and actor)
secrets in Password fields and .env files, never in git, logs, the guide or images
no third-party calls from the screens (fonts served locally)
console static files: path traversal refused
every applicant text escaped before display
the LLM never sees nationality, gender, age, name, photo or IDs
deleting an applicant de-identifies the audit rows
